100011.t: Ah, dammit... What is this? Why is it so dark?
I have no idea where I am. I was just at home a second ago...
Thinking maybe the lights were off, I reached around in the dark.
But I couldn't feel anything.
Strange, the wall should be right around here...
I reached farther out, feeling around as I took a few steps forward.
After a few steps, my hands suddenly found something soft and squishy.
I could just barely make something out... but I still couldn't tell what it was.
Wait, that sound just now... was that a woman's voice?
A-Ahem...
At last... we finally meet.
Truly... I never thought this day would come.
I've been waiting here for so long... waiting for you to come.
...I should have introduced myself sooner.
My name is Dandelion.
My role is to guide Masters like you who have just arrived in this world.
Just say the word, and whatever you desire, Master...
Um... I'm sorry, but before I continue, could you please move your hands...?
...I was so out of it, I hadn't even realized I was still holding onto that "something."
Well, no wonder I kept feeling that soft, squishy sensation...
Give it a gentle poke
Give it a squeeze
Huh...? Wh-What...?
W-What are you doing...!
Poke it a few more times
Squeeze it a few more times
Kyaaaaaaaaaah!
W-W-W-What are you doing!!!
Humanitas Downtown Alley
*Huff* *puff*... Hey, did you guys grab enough? My hands are completely full here!
Heh, of course! By the way, what's with that giant bread, Theta?
Campagne. A loaf large enough to feed all of us. The baguettes Lumina and Freya are carrying are good too, but when it comes to sheer quantity, the campagne...
Hey, are you crazy?! There's no way they won't notice if something that huge just disappea—
Hey!!
You damn thieves! Again?! How many times is this gonna happen?!
You even stole my prized campagne! This time, I'm gonna teach you a lesson you'll never forget!!
How about you put down that chainsaw before you start threatening us?!
A chainsaw?! What are you talking about?! This is a fully automatic bread knife!!
It's custom-made! The only one of its kind in the world!!
It was originally made to slice bread... but it works just as well on bread thieves!
This is all your fault, Theta! You just had to grab that giant loaf and make a run for it!
The biggest problem was you, Freya, singing at excessive volume to celebrate our success.
Now, now, stop fighting and just run away!
That side alley up ahead! Let's lose her there!!
DD TOWN
Phew... did we lose her? We lost her, right?!
Don't jinx it, Freya.
Jinx or not, let's take this chance to get back to the hideout…
Oh my? There's something shining in the sky...
High energy reaction detected. 5 seconds until impact. Please brace for impact.
Impact?! Something's falling?! What's going on?!
BOOOOOM!!!!

100021.t: (Ugh... I almost got myself killed, groping around on instinct like that...)
(By the way... this doesn't hurt as much as I expected. I fell from pretty high up... Gah!!)
(Gah... I can't breathe!! I'm being crushed!! What the hell...?!)
(What is it this time?! First it was boobs, and now...?!)
Something big, heavy, soft, and pink was pressing down on my face.
Under different circumstances, I would've been thrilled to find myself in this position.
However...

My face was wedged so tightly between her thighs
that I couldn't even turn my head to breathe.
Mmph!! Mmph, mmph!!
Ah... What's this warm, damp air...?♡
Ugh, I don't know or care! Just do something about the bread first!!
...Battery low... Requesting immediate bread supply... *rumble*...
Ah, is this the end...
Losing consciousness while pinned under a girl's lower half...
Come to think of it, maybe this isn't such a bad way to go...
What is this...? This chest feels different from earlier...
Ah, you're awake? What a relief!
Seriously, Dandelion... She really needs to stop lashing out whenever she panics.
Suffocating on your very first day... I certainly didn't see that coming, but...

I'll fix you up like nothing ever happened,
so it'll feel like you just woke up from a little nap!
Here I go! Hyaaa!!
Phew!! I can finally breathe...!!
Kyaa, that tickles!

Ah, whatever!! Just get off me first!
You're really heavy!

Oh my, have I really gained that much weight recently?
What do you think, Freya?
If you can gain weight after starving for a week, that's terrifying in its own right!
Forget about her weight. Hurry up and pick up whatever bread we can salvage.
I can't exactly move right now either... Theta, can you help us?
Zzz... Charging in progress... If you require assistance, please contact the customer service center using your Quartz number...
GET. OFF. ME!!!
Kyaaah?!
Mustering every ounce of my strength, I rolled my body to the side.
With their "cushion" gone, all three girls tumbled over and rolled around on the floor.
Argh! All the bread we worked so hard to gather is ruined!
We'll just have to pick up the pieces and eat them. Though we should probably dust them off first?

Fortunately, the campagne wasn't pulverized.
As expected of such a large, sturdy, magnificent loaf.
My goodness! It survived a shockwave that even the baguettes couldn't withstand. How impressive!

Tch, this is all because of that guy who fell from the sky!!
What are you gonna do about our bread—
...Huh? Why are your clothes...

Just as I was about to ask what was wrong with my clothes,
sirens began wailing loudly from all directions.
Kihihit♡ Jackpot!
Huh? What, Blondie, Pinkie, Purple... you guys again?
Uhuhut♡ Getting caught again right after getting out? You really are hopeless thieves♡
Ugh, I've told you to call us by our names already!
Freya! Theta! Lumina! Together, we are [MAke Drama]!
Yeah, yeah. You can introduce yourselves again when we check your identities back at the prison, okay?

Hueeng... You vicious bread thieves...!
Please put down your weapons and surrender...!
Ahaha, I'd really rather not get caught this time!
Exactly! We haven't even gotten a single bite of bread yet. Like hell we're letting you catch us!
Prepare for combat. We shall resist to the end...
If you surrender peacefully, I'll give each of you a donut on the way...
Oh my, well then, I suppose we have no choice...♡
Deal accepted. Surrendering immediately.
*Sigh*... Here, my wrists! Cuff me!
What is this, some kind of comedy routine? What the hell is going on...?
Sigh, whatever. I'd better not get involved.
Just as I was trying to slip away...

Kyaah! Th-That person behind you...
w-w-why... is he naked?!
What's this? Naked in a place like this? Pervert♡ Exhibitionist♡ Apologize to all of us decent, fully dressed people♡
I-I'll have to arrest you for public indecency...
...What? Public indecency? I didn't—
Oh, crap, I'm actually not wearing any clothes?!
Wait, so I've been naked this entire time?!
I-I don't care about public indecency! I don't even know why I'm naked in the first place!!

Besides, isn't your very existence public indecency?!
Are those even clothes, or just scraps of fabric?!
Everyone stared at me in silence for a moment.
Huh? Isn't this pretty normal? It'd be different if it were the Day of Freedom.
Right, right. Can't even keep track of what day it is? What a loser♡
Even on the Day of Freedom, walking around stark naked without a single thread on is a big no-no!
Anyway, Goldie! Do you know this weird guy?
Hmm...
Hehe, if I say we know him, they'll give us another donut, right? I could probably snag at least a bite...
Yep! He's with us! And he's a big eater, if you catch my drift.
Kihihit♡ Great! That's theft plus public indecency, so I'll throw in one donut per charge!

Dammit, seriously! Who said you could decide I'm your buddy or arrest me?!
I've got nothing to do with these people!!
No way. I couldn't let myself get wrongfully arrested like this. I had to escape somehow...
Hey! You three bread thieves over there! Don't you think this is unfair too?!
Huh? What are you talking about? What's unfair about it?

I'm the one being treated unfairly here!
I just fell into some random place with no clothes on, and now I'm getting arrested?!
You only stole a few pieces of bread! And they're throwing you straight in jail without even a trial? How does that make any sense?!
Oh my, but stealing is still stealing, after all... Just like being stark naked is still being naked.
And sweet donuts are the answer to everything. I'm not just saying that because I'm starving.
Hey, why are you suddenly agreeing with them! Just grab your weapons and fight back! Resist!
Oho, resisting arrest now? Kihihit♡ The charges just keep piling up today.
Suddenly, Blondie's expression changed.
Ah, right, right...
Oh, we're being treated unfairly. So unfair.
I guess we can't just let ourselves get caught like this, can we?
Suddenly, the blonde girl broke free from the police and started walking toward me.
Seeing this, Pinkie and Purple nodded as if they understood.
Fufufu, now that I think about it, you're right... We can't just let this slide.
Message received. I will dedicate all remaining battery power to combat.

The three of them walked over and readied their weapons.
And seeing this, the police...
Hnnng, I knew it would come to this...
Kyahahat♡ Not only are we getting a special meal, we might even earn some extra time off!

100031.t: Hey, you frauds! You're totally fine, so why are you lying there like you're unconscious?!
Be honest. You never had any intention of fighting in the first place, did you?!
Additional charges confirmed! Thanks for the extra donuts!

Uhuhut♡ You're quick on the uptake. Anyway, arrest complete!
Time to go, you hardened criminals♡
Laila! Give that naked guy a blanket or something!
Y-Yes... U-Um, Mr. Naked Criminal? If you could hold out your hand...
Damn it, like hell I'm letting you catch me—!!
I tried to shove the approaching girl aside and make a run for it, but...
*Squish—*
Kyaat! If you t-touch me so suddenly... I-It's kind of a problem...!
What, what? So you're a pervert, an exhibitionist, and a groper all at once?
You're the worst♡ Criminal♡ Apologize to Laila's breasts♡
Kihihit. Marcia's going to punish this bad boy.
WHACK!!!
The blow to the back of my head sent my vision spinning, and I started to lose consciousness.
And just before I blacked out, a voice whispered close to my ear.
Heh. Looking forward to having you around, Naked Boy.
And... all your donuts are mine!☆
God... dammit...
Leave me...  just one...

Humanitas Correctional Facility for Inmates
Panoticon
Now, since the room assignments are all done, let's go take a picture, Master!
I'm not going.
Too much hassle.
Aw, Master! Don't be like that! Your companions are all waiting outside, you know!
Even if you're only checking in today and leaving tomorrow, once you're here, everyone has to take a Prison Four-Cut! No exceptions!
A correctional facility established to maintain social order and rehabilitate its citizens: Panoticon.
It was supposedly a correctional facility, but judging by the interior and the service, it was basically a luxury hotel...
The strangest thing about this place was that almost every inmate only stayed for a single day.
And apparently, the only thing they made you do during that one day was take this "Prison Four-Cut"...
Why don't you take it in your master's place?
Can't a maid at least do that much?
B-But still...

Even if you are the Master, you still have to do what you're supposed to do!
Shouldn't you be a little more aware of the situation you're in?
My situation? You mean being wrongfully arrested?
Wrongfully? That can't be right... You're here because you were stark naked in the middle of the street, remember?
I don't know, I don't remember.
A-And... it says here that you were caught red-handed as part of a four-person bread theft gang.
On top of that, you fought with the police, obstructed them in the line of duty, and more...
I keep telling you, I don't even know those bread-crazy girls! They decided to fight on their own too!!
Oh! You're still here!
Lucky you, getting a nice room all to yourself! The three of us have to share, so ours is cramped...
Shut up. It's only cramped because there are three of you.

Ah, I have to go attend to someone else, so I'll be off!
Freya, I'll leave the rest to you...
And please make sure to get those pictures taken...!
Come on, let's go take the pictures already! You look amazing in photos here!
Everyone's waiting, so hurry up!
Who takes a mugshot like it's some fun little photo shoot?!
Hehe! Who cares! It's fun!
Do you really have nothing better to have fun with... *Sigh*
Nothing I said seemed to get through to her, and the more I talked, the more pointless it felt.
Sigh, fine. I'm going, I'm going! It's not like I have anything better to do anyway...

100041.t: Click. Click. Photography complete. Next, Lumina's turn.
Mmm... I think this outfit looks the best...
Looks good! But isn't it a bit small?
Oh, I should probably change soon, too.
I was speechless as the three of them casually stripped down and changed right in front of me.
...Well, I'm glad I came. Nice view, too.
The view is pretty nice. They've even spruced the place up for the photos!

You get a great view of Humanitas, too!
Heheh, see? Listening to me always pays off!
What? You don't know Humanitas? That's the name of this city.

I keep telling you, I'm not from around here!
Anyway, so I just change into this and take the photo, right?

Oh, you also need to write your name and birthday on that paper.
That way, it'll be easy to find your record the next time you rent one.

100051.t: After finishing the Prison Four-Cut, I returned to my room.
By the time I got back, the maids had already prepared dinner.
Seriously, why did these three bring their food all the way to my room instead of eating in their own room?!
Ah... I'm stuffed. I finally feel alive.
They said the nutritionist here used to be a chef at a famous hotel.
After starving for a week, I finally feel alive again. I'm even starting to think I wouldn't mind living here.
The food here is starting to taste like my mom's cooking.
Ahaha, we really do come here quite often.
Still, we managed to go quite a while without getting caught this time. That's a record in its own way.
No, but seriously, why did you all gather in my room?!
Come on, don't be like that! We're accomplices now, aren't we? We should bond!
Who says we're accomplices?! Unlike you guys, I didn't steal any bread. My only crime was falling out of the sky stark naked!!
Innocent citizens do not fall naked from the sky. They fall fully clothed.
If you had worn at least as much as I do, you might not have been arrested.
I really don't want to hear that from you of all people...
By the way, {player}, may I ask you one thing?
Sigh... What is it?
Do you... really have no idea where Humanitas is?
(Ugh, my head... What was that just now...?)
...Ahem.
I told you, I'm not from around here. Of course I don't know.
Freya and Lumina exchanged surprised looks for a moment, then began whispering to each other.
There's no way anyone could not know Humanitas... Maybe he lost all his memories when he landed on his head earlier?
Maybe... Or maybe all his clothes burned up when he fell...
What a pitiful soul. At least we have clothes and common sense.

...I didn't even feel like arguing anymore.
They wouldn't believe me even if I explained, so whatever. They could believe what they wanted.
It was a little annoying how they kept looking at me like they felt sorry for me, though.
I do not know how you ended up falling from the sky, but if it happens again, I recommend acquiring a pair of [Aerosphere] wings like mine.
I have absolutely no intention of falling again! I've already almost died two or three times today. Why would I want to go through any more of that?!
Oh, stop joking around! No one dies from something like that!
Even if you get severely injured, paramedics will rush over and heal you in an instant, you know?
Huh...? Oh, come to think of it, there was gunfire and explosions everywhere earlier, but you're all completely fine.
Buildings or cars might be a different story, but people don't break that easily.
It would take something with the firepower of a naval cannon to hurt us even a little.
...It seemed I had fallen into a world where my common sense did not apply.
...I think I get the gist of it. So, what exactly do you guys do? And what is [MAke Drama] anyway?

It's a little embarrassing now that you're actually asking me to explain...
A-Ahem! It's a long story, but I guess it can't be helped!
...Never mind Freya. Someone else explain. Keep it brief.
Hey!!
Fufufu... Actually, we're just friends who got together because we were bored with our everyday lives.
We just formed the group to make our boring lives a little more fun.
Of course, that said, we haven't actually done much as a group.
For the rest of the time... we mostly take naps, go to part-time job interviews, and steal food.
So your daily routine is stealing bread and going in and out of prison?
W-Well, not exactly... but, you know, we still have to eat, so things just kind of ended up this way...
Countless emotions flashed through Freya's eyes.
Right, even in a world where you don't easily get hurt, making a living is still important...
Come to think of it, I was in a similar boat.
In this world, I was a complete outsider.
The moment I left this prison and parted ways with them, I'd have nothing. Not even a change of clothes.
I might have no choice but to keep ending up in prison like these guys just to survive...
...Wait.
So basically, you guys are a bunch of hopelessly bored, unemployed slackers, right?
Jobless?! That's harsh!
Though I can't really deny it.
...I have no grounds to object.
It looks like... you guys are stuck in a rut.
The same routine every day, the same unchanging streets, the same mind-numbingly boring world. Right?

...Huh?
You're right! How did you know?!
For life to be fun, you need new challenges.
Invest those boring lives of yours in me.
Then I'll take responsibility as your leader and shake up your lives.
Ooh... That sounds rather grand...
...But what exactly do you plan to do?
First, we need to pull off something nobody would ever expect.
We're going to break out of prison.
Whaaaaaaat?!
Wow, how bold.
...A prison break. That's new.
We're only here for a day anyway. I doubt anyone's ever even tried to break out.
Besides, even if we fail... well, we just get to lounge around and eat for another day!
W-Well, that is true, but...
Hmm, that actually makes a lot of sense...
Hehehe, luckily, it looks like those two will be easy to convince.
My plan was simple: attempt a prison break and fail.
If I kept this up, I could live comfortably in this hotel forever.

Still, if I went alone, I might get caught before I could even make a real attempt,
so I needed to drag them into it and make a big show of the whole thing.
Hehehe... Five-star hotel service forever. I really am a genius!
That is logical. However...
...It is an inefficient choice.
...I didn't expect this! Don't tell me Theta is going to oppose—
Are you planning to give up a warm, comfortable bed for the night and a lavish hotel breakfast tomorrow morning?
As long as we break out before we're released tomorrow, it still counts as a prison break.
...Oh, you've got a point. Are you some kind of genius?
Heh. It was the obvious conclusion.
Phew, that was a close call.
I almost had to give up on my "Panoticon Regular" plan before I even put it into action.
Ahaha, count me in! It sounds like fun!
...Oh, whatever! Let's just do it!
Alright, it's settled. Get some sleep, everyone. See you tomorrow morning.
Now get out of my room! I want some peace and quiet for once!
The morning sun is up, Master!
It's an important day today. You need to wake up!
Ugh... Just five more minutes...
No, make it ten more minutes...
Master, it's almost time for breakfast! Do you really want to miss the buffet?
Buffet!!!
*Yawn*...
Hey, Maid. I have a question.
Yes, Master?
It's too much trouble. Can't you just bring me a whole plate from the buffet as room service?
If you're fine with a plate filled with mint chocolate, sure...
...Never mind. I'll just go myself.

As the maid scurried out,
I put on my clothes and got ready to head out.
By the way, did those idiots even wake up?
Hey, you maids over there.
Are those three idiots who were locked up with me awake?
Ah, if you mean the other three bread-thief Masters, they're still...
The three of them are notorious for oversleeping on release day every time they're locked up here.
Even when we try to wake them, it's no use. We've completely given up...
Oh, for crying out loud. Hey, where are their rooms?!
*Snore*...
Ah... Th-That spot is sensitive...
Mumble mumble... Bread heaven is right in front of me...
When I barged into their room, I was greeted by three lazybones.
Wake up, you idiots!!!!
I screamed with all my might... but not a single soul woke up.

I tried everything from opening the blinds to throwing open the windows, but...
in the end, not a single one of them woke up.
Alright, so you want to do this the hard way, huh?
For the sake of my comfortable life in this new world, I was more than ready to become a demon.
Actually, I'd already done my part by putting up with them for this long.
I went straight to the bathroom, turned on the cold water, and filled a bucket...
I told you to wake up!!!!
Then I dumped it all over the bed.
Kyaaaah!!! It's freezing!!!
Ah... I-I would've preferred a lotion shower.
My bread...
One of them had a weird reaction, and another barely reacted at all... but whatever. They were awake, and that was all that mattered.
Alright, raise your hand if you forgot what we're doing this morning.
I didn't forget!! I remember it perfectly!!
Th-That's right! It's definitely not because I was having such a nice dream that I didn't want to wake up...
Enemy of bread. Theta will remember this.
Forget the dreams and excuses. The maids said you guys have never once managed to get up on time in the morning.
Ah, ahahaha...! C-Come on, no way...
Th-That's right! Do you have any idea how diligent we are?
Food. Cannot be missed.
Then what about all the breakfasts you've missed so far?
Look at them going quiet because they have nothing to say.
After finishing breakfast like that...
Alright, then you all know the plan.
First, we commandeer the elevator here and take it down to the lobby.
Second, we deliberately pass through the areas with the most maids so they let their guard down.
Finally, we walk straight out the front door like we own the place.
What? Any questions?
Is there really a point to taking a route where everyone can see us?
And we don't need to take any other precautions?
I considered disguises, but finding maid uniforms that fit all of you on such short notice would be harder than the escape itself.
Ah, that makes sense. Besides, I prefer the clothes I have on now anyway.
Even if the maid uniforms fit, all our equipment would stick out through them and give us away.
Well, if the Big Boss says so, then that's that!Ahaha!!
Idiots. These guys are real idiots.

I planned a route that would get us caught no matter what
and even prepared a few stories to convince them, but...

Great. Now all I have to do is get caught trying to escape
and enjoy my five-star hotel life behind bars forever...!!
Whoa! We actually made it out! On our very first try!
It is rather surprising that we made it out without a single fight.
We would have won even if there had been a fight. Current energy charge: optimal.

As expected of our leader... No, our Big Boss! My heart was pounding every time a maid showed up because I thought we'd get caught!
Ah, that was so thrilling and fun!

It really felt like we were filming an escape scene in a stealth-action movie.
At this rate, maybe we can just waltz right in next time.
If we get hungry in the future, should we raid this place instead of a bakery, Theta?
Sounds good. However, we must continue sampling the bakery's bread at regular intervals.
(This isn't how this was supposed to go. This is all wrong! What happened to my cozy prison life where I was guaranteed to get caught and thrown back in??)
(Something's wrong. Were we already released? Or could we always just walk out? But then why'd they react like that...?)
Oh my, a huge crowd is suddenly heading our way...
They are all holding something in their hands. Could they be... the maids' minions?!
Ugh, I guess they won't let us go that easily...!
(...! I knew things couldn't be that hopeless! If I get caught again now...)
Take this tofu!!!!!!
SPLAT!!!!

100061.t: Kyaah! Something wet and mushy got right in between my breasts!!
Oh my, your face is covered in so much white stuff too...♡
A musty but slightly nutty smell... Th-This is...
Congrats on getting out of prison!! How's our special tofu?!
Delicious, right? Amazing, right? Don't you wanna buy some??
If you become a regular starting today, you'll get a 20% discount and a weekly tofu set delivered right to your doorstep!

Like hell I'm buying any!!!
Who starts a sales pitch by throwing tofu in someone's face?!
More importantly, we barely have any money... Even if we wanted to buy it, we couldn't.
Eh?
This month's rent is going to be tight... This time, we're really broke.
My bank balance is starting to look seriously bad too... I might have to live on weeds for a while.
Ahaha! Is that all? If that's the case, it's totally fine!
Want to try some samples before you go? Not many customers get released this early, so I didn't prepare much...
The other tofu vendors will be here soon, so you might want to hurry.
We must escape quickly. The next thing flying our way might be stinky tofu.
Eek! Let's get out of here, fast!!!
Hey, hey! Where are you grabbing me all of a sudden—
Tch, they really took off fast.
Come to think of it, hardly anyone gets released at this hour. Did something change?
Maybe I should open the shop a bit earlier! Ahaha!
Whew, we're finally here! I need to go wash up, fast!!
Ah, me too. The bits of tofu from earlier are going to dry onto me.
...Me as well, then.

I somehow ended up getting dragged all the way here.
For a hideout belonging to a bunch of broke idiots, this place looks surprisingly spacious and decent. Let's see...

...The fridge is completely empty. No electricity either...
*Sigh* I knew this world's common sense was different, but I didn't think it'd be this different.
I really can't go on like this...Oh, whatever. I might as well turn off my brain and just live.
Well, my plan to become a permanent resident of a five-star prison failed, so... my first goal is...
Taking over Panoticon.
If I couldn't stay there, I'd just have to take it over.
Screw the law. I'll just stay in prison of my own free will... Who's going to stop me?
The problem is how I'm supposed to pull that off...
Ah, whatever. I'll think about it later.
It's been a hectic morning, and I'm exhausted... I'll get some shut-eye on the sofa for a bit...
...Wait.
So right now... three beautiful girls are showering together in the next room...?
They might be a little messed up in the head, but the rest of them... The rest of them looked pretty damn good...
No way... Is this my cha... nce...
...Where am I? I'm pretty sure I fell asleep on the sofa.
Is this... my second chance to sneak a peek at them in the shower...?!!!
No, it's not!
?!! Who are you?!
Oh, come on! We just met recently, and you've already forgotten me?
What are you talking about? Recently...? Besides, the one I met here last time was blonde...
Boo... You remember Dandelion, but not me? I'm hurt.
No, I'm telling you, I really don't remember you at all.
Hmm... Well, you were out of it back then, and my appearance was different...
She looked a bit down, but what did she expect me to do when I really didn't remember?!
A-Anyway! Forget that for now!! You just got here, so it's been a lot, right?
Actually, last time, I could only make a temporary contract with you on my own, so I couldn't give you something important.
While I'm at it, I'll also provide you with the forces you'll need to take over Panoticon!
An important thing...? Reinforcements...? Wait. More importantly, you know I'm from another world?

Oh, come to think of it, I haven't introduced myself yet!
I'm Ami! One of the goddesses of this world!
And you, Master... are someone this world simply can't do without!
That's why my sisters and I took the liberty of summoning you, Master, but...
Ahaha, nobody expected things to turn out like this!
No, I don't understand any of this goddess stuff or why I'm supposedly so important?!
...Explanation. Keep it simple. Three-line summary.
That's impossible!!!
Tch. What a useless goddess.

Hmph... I may not look it, but I'm actually one of the highest-ranking goddesses...
I only look like this because I gave you all my power last time, Master...
This little kid is a high-ranking goddess? Huh...
Hmph! I'm not a little kid! If I could just get back the [Aura] you took from me, Master, I could return to my original tall and beautiful form!!
Aura? What on earth is that?

You'll probably ask for a three-line summary anyway, so I won't bother with a boring explanation...
Just think of it as the most primal and sacred power in this world...

Pretty half-assed...
